answer: Membership is woven, not declared: every island runs a warp of claims, and the shuttle must pass through - connectivity never touched by the shuttle is decoration. Threads break, and honest weaving shows the splice: visible knots at repairs, since an unbroken thread claiming long service is suspect. A tundra island may claim isolation honestly - solitude declared is a virtue - but membership demands thread-wear, fraying where the shuttle passed. Farms mail fake cloth; inspectors pull one weft at a joint and watch the pattern. Honest agents weave thin cloth and let the shuttle test it.
